# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 3 tokens; Text — 3 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 2 tokens; Borders and rings — 1 token; Palette ramps and brand — 15 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 8 tokens; Radius — 5 tokens; Shadow — 2 tokens; Layout — 3 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the dark theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface-1, #0e1116);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="light" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the light column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--surface-1, #f7f9fc);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #0e1116;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | dark | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface-1` | #0e1116 | #f7f9fc | Barre de titre, barre latérale, champs de saisie. Texte `text` et `text-muted` dessus. |
| `--surface-2` | #12151b | #ffffff | Cartes et widgets (légèrement surélevés, avec `border` et `shadow-card`). Texte `text` et `text-muted` dessus. |
| `--surface-3` | #1a1f28 | #e7ecf4 | Survol de ligne, bouton segmenté actif, bulle d'info au survol des graphiques. Texte `text` et `text-muted` dessus. |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the dark theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--text, #e8ecf2);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="light" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the light column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--text, #121722);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #e8ecf2;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | dark | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--text` | #e8ecf2 | #121722 | Texte principal et valeurs chiffrées sur `surface-1`, `surface-2`, `surface-3`. |
| `--text-muted` | #8a94a6 | #4f5a6e | Libellés, unités, axes, texte secondaire sur `bg`, `surface-1`, `surface-2`, `surface-3` (≥ 4,5:1 dans les deux thèmes). |

**Interaction states** (same roles, suffixed):

| token | dark | light |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--text-disabled` | #4a5365 | #9aa4b5 |

## Color · Fills and status backgrounds

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the dark theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--on-accent, #04222b);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="light" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the light column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--on-accent, #ffffff);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #04222b;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | dark | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--on-accent` | #04222b | #ffffff | Texte et icônes posés sur un fond `accent` (bouton primaire, logo, interrupteur actif). À recalculer si l'utilisateur change l'accent. |
| `--on-crit` | #0a0c10 | #ffffff | Texte sur un fond `crit` (pastille de compteur d'alertes, bouton de confirmation). |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the dark theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--bg, #0a0c10);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="light" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the light column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--bg, #eef1f6);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #0a0c10;
```

### Tokens (15)

| token | dark | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--bg` | #0a0c10 | #eef1f6 | Fond de la fenêtre, derrière les cartes. Jamais de texte courant directement dessus hors titres de page. |
| `--control-border` | #5f6b80 | #7a869b | Bordure des contrôles interactifs (boutons, champs, interrupteurs, boutons de ventilateur). Atteint 3:1 sur `surface-2` et `surface-3`. |

| `--accent` | #00d4ff | #006f8c | Couleur d'accent PERSONNALISABLE (cyan par défaut) : état normal des jauges, courbe principale, élément actif, boutons primaires. En thème clair, variante assombrie (≥ 4,5:1 sur `surface-2`). À écraser par variable CSS dans Paramètres. |
| `--ok` | #3ddc84 | #0b7d42 | Statut « bon » (SMART sain, connecté). Toujours accompagné du mot ou d'une icône, jamais seul. |
| `--warn` | #ffc93c | #9a6000 | Attention : jauge au seuil d'avertissement, alerte jaune. Toujours accompagnée d'un libellé ou d'une icône. |
| `--crit` | #ff4d5e | #c8283b | Critique : jauge au seuil critique, alerte rouge, bouton « Fermer » au survol. Toujours accompagné d'un libellé ou d'une icône. |
| `--overlay-bg` | #0a0c10b8 | #ffffffd1 | Fond translucide du widget compact et de l'overlay de jeu (le jeu reste visible derrière). |
| `--preset-cyan` | #00d4ff | #006f8c | Préréglage d'accent Cyan (défaut). Valeur sombre / valeur claire à injecter dans `accent`. |
| `--preset-vert` | #3ddc84 | #0b7d42 | Préréglage d'accent Vert. Valeur sombre / valeur claire à injecter dans `accent`. |
| `--preset-orange` | #ff8a3d | #b34700 | Préréglage d'accent Orange. Valeur sombre / valeur claire à injecter dans `accent`. |
| `--preset-rose` | #ff5fa2 | #b8236b | Préréglage d'accent Rose. Valeur sombre / valeur claire à injecter dans `accent`. |
| `--preset-violet` | #b58cff | #6b3fcc | Préréglage d'accent Violet. Valeur sombre / valeur claire à injecter dans `accent`. |

| ramp | step and value (dark) | step and value (light) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--series-*` | 2 #ff8a3d, 3 #b58cff | 2 #b34700, 3 #6b3fcc |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 600 22px/26px "Barlow", system-ui, sans-serif;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-title-page);
font-family: var(--font-ui);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title-page` | `.title-page`, `--text-title-page` | 22px / 26px | 600 | `ui` | Titre de page (Accueil, CPU…). |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 12px / 16px, letter-spacing 0.06em | 500 | `ui` | Titre de carte et en-tête de colonne. Toujours en MAJUSCULES (text-transform: uppercase). |
| `nav` | `.nav`, `--text-nav` | 14px / 20px | 500 | `ui` | Libellés de la barre latérale, boutons. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 14px / 20px | 400 | `ui` | Texte courant et descriptions de réglage. |
| `body-sm` | `.body-sm`, `--text-body-sm` | 13px / 18px | 400 | `ui` | Texte secondaire, lignes de tableau, sous-titres de page. |
| `caption` | `.caption`, `--text-caption` | 12px / 16px | 400 | `ui` | Légendes, pastilles d'état. |
| `value-xl` | `.value-xl`, `--text-value-xl` | 40px / 44px | 500 | `mono` | Valeur héros (FPS de l'overlay, grande jauge). |
| `value` | `.value`, `--text-value` | 28px / 32px | 500 | `mono` | Valeur principale d'une carte de métrique. |
| `value-md` | `.value-md`, `--text-value-md` | 18px / 24px | 500 | `mono` | Valeur secondaire (débit, tr/min). |
| `data` | `.data`, `--text-data` | 13px / 18px | 400 | `mono` | Chiffres de tableau, sous-valeurs, bulles d'info. |
| `axis` | `.axis`, `--text-axis` | 11px / 14px | 400 | `mono` | Graduations d'axes des graphiques. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ui` | `--font-ui` | `"Barlow", system-ui, sans-serif` |
| `mono` | `--font-mono` | `"JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (8)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Écart icône–texte serré, espace entre barres de signal. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Écart entre petits contrôles, padding vertical de pastille. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Écart libellé–valeur, padding de bouton, marge sous un titre de carte. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Gouttière de la grille de widgets et padding de carte. |
| `--space-5` | 20px | Marge verticale de la zone principale. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Marge horizontale de la zone principale. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Séparation entre groupes de réglages. |
| `--space-12` | 48px | Grandes respirations (cover, états vides). |

## Shadow

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--shadow-card: 0 1px 0 #ffffff0a inset, 0 6px 18px #00000066 in the dark theme; the table gives its value in the others) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--shadow-card), so that a change to tokens.css, or a change of theme, reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--shadow-card` | 0 1px 0 #ffffff0a inset, 0 6px 18px #00000066 · light: 0 1px 2px #1217221f, 0 4px 14px #12172214 | Cartes au repos : léger relief sur le fond. |
| `--shadow-lift` | 0 16px 40px #000000b3 · light: 0 14px 34px #12172238 | Widget en cours de déplacement, bulle d'info de graphique, overlay. |
